check_na.name: python_tests
check_na.rationale: Nine tests in tests/api/test_workflows.py and tests/api/test_system_vertical.py fail on this Windows machine in whole-file runs and pass in isolation. Reproduced identically on an untouched origin/main worktree, so they are not caused by this change, which touches only desktop/scripts, desktop/test, .github/workflows and a spec. The same tests are green in CI (PR #2173, Test 3.11 and 3.13 both pass), so this is local shared-state leakage of the tracked Windows class, not a defect being hidden.
